tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bya tshul gyi chog bsgrig dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bya tshul gyi chog bsgrig dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil

'khor sgrub mchod bya tshul gyi chog bsgrig dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mdun bskyed bsgrub tshul zhig 'chad par bya ste/ de yang rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar bsgrub cing mchod pa ni rje'i de nyid rab gsal sogs las shes par bya zhing*/ skabs 'dir ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i tshul tsam zhig dgod pa'i dang po ni/ gnas yid dang mthun par stegs ji ltar 'tshams pa'i steng du grub na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor tshad ldan leb mor bkrams nas mdun du nyer spyod sogs lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ ma 'byor na de bstun gyis bya zhing*/ chu bzhi sogs gzhung nas bshad pa rnams kyang bsham/ spyir mdun bskyaid la bdag mdun tha dad dang tha mi dad kyi sgrub tshul gnyis yod kyang*/ 'dir phyi ma ltar bya ba yin la/ de yang bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du btang ste/ rang nyid bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs par mos nas/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ zhes pa dang nang mchod bum chu gang rigs kyis bsangs/ shū n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba/ zhes pa nas/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā oṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ bcu rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ spyan/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ ut+pal/ me long dmar po/ pi wang sngon po/ dri'i dung chos/ ro snod/ klu shing gi me tog sdong po dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa/ 'khor lo/ /rin po che gnyis/ pad+ma gnyis/ ral gri gnyis/ tho ba/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa/

pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ral gri/ zhags pa/ ral gri dang ral gri/ gtsug tor gyi mtshan ma dang zhags pa/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la'ang mtshan ma bskyed tshul 'di ltar bya ba ni rje'i dgongs pa yin te/ /de nyid rab gsal las/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshul de ni ras bris kyi cho ga la yang bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na da lta kha cig dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ltar bskyed pa ni rje'i dgongs pa cung min no/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rim gyis lha sum cu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la rang nyid mi bskyod pa zhi ba mthing nag mi bskyod pa'i dbus rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhes pa nas/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas rang rigs kyi rig ma phyung*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā/ zhes pa nas/ haṃ rig ma stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ las kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gos/ de yongs su gyur pa las reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhes pa nas sham thabs 'phyar ba/ 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus na yab sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ zhes pa nas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ji ltar bzhin no/ /yum gyi spyi gtsug nas skra mtshams kyi bar du oṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhes pa nas lte ba nas brla'i rtsa ba'i bar du hā ljang ku yongs su gyur pa las/ don grub ljang gu zhes pa nas/ nor bu 'dzin pa/ yab ky-i gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ zhes pa nas/ bu ga yi ge phaṭa ser pos bkang pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang bar gyur/ hūṃ snyoms par 'jug pa'i las la gnas par byas pas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs pa'i thig le cha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur/

de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ bcu rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rim gyis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid mi bskyod pa zhes pa nas/ shar lhor rang nyid gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /zhes pa nas/ shar du rang nyid byams pa dang*/ sa snying dkar po zhes pa nas/ shar du rang nyid gshin rje gshed ces pa nas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs par gyur/ mi bskyod pa rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dh+rika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phyogs bcur 'phros/ chos 'khor bskor ba la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par du yang sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul ba rnams gcig tu 'dus/ zhes pa na/ gnod mdzes rgyal po rang gi thugs kar drangs/ sum+bha rā dza thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phyogs bcur 'phros/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug dang klu dang sa bdag gi gdon bcom/ sprul ba rnams gcig tu 'dus/ de thams cad kyang rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs te/ rang rang gi ye shes pa dang gcig tu gyur nas mchog tu dga' ba'i sku dang ldan pas slar 'byon bar bzhed pa'i sgo nas bzhugs par gyur/ rang dang rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i nang du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig sngon po/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i lha gzhan rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la rang rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa re re/

ye shes sems dpa' de rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ /rin po che/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ de rnams kyi dbus su ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' khaṃ oṃ swā āḥhā/ laṃ māṃ paṃ tāṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: maiṃ th+l+hiṃ oṃ oṃ*/ oṃ hūṃ oṃ saṃ/ hūṃ bcu rnams 'od zer gyi phung po chen po dang bcas par gyur/ rang dang dam tshig pa'i lha gzhan rnams kyi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pa rnams gcig tu gyur pas ye shes pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs can rnams kyi thugs kar btab pas bskul ba'i 'og tu rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gnod mdzes bkug nas mdun du bka' nod pa la rgyal ba rnams 'byon par bskul zhing*/ ces bka' bsgos pas des kyang rang rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs shing*/ de rnams kyang rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so la thim pas rang mi bskyod pa zhi ba de yongs su gyur pa las zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag / nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'od dmar po 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i dbus na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs par gyur/ e h+ye hi bha ga wa na sa ma ya ma nu sma ra tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ma nu sma ra sma ra oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyi rgyal ba rnams spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa pū dza zhes pa nas/ spar+sha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shi ye āḥhūṃ/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad/ mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig

/lan gsum/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ sta gon yod na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis nam mkhar bteg pa'i sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa zhes pa nas/ spar sha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrīḥbe āḥhūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis= gyur/ zhes bya/ lha so so'i rigs bdag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyud kyis lha so so la dbang bskur bar gyur/ sta gon ma byas na sta gon gyi lha 'bebs rgyu med pas/ ras bris la brten bdag gis tshul de gnyis phyed par bya ste/ / bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor ji lta bu ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /rang nyid gtso bo la mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du phye nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol du mchod pa'i las la gnas par gyur/ mchod pa rnams las bum gyi chus bsang zhing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+rān+ta kṛ ta hūṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā zhes pa nas āt+ma ko ྅haṃ/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du aṃ paṃ buṃ la sogs pa zhes pa nas mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /zhes pa nas/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skye bar gyur/ oṃ ār+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ añtsa mā ṇaṃ/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ spa ra āḥhūṃ/ zhes sbyar te so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /oṃ āḥhriḥpra wa ra sa da ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/

de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /zhal bsil mchog 'di dag / bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /ces sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad kyi mthar/ rim bzhin/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñtsa ma ṇaṃ/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ ces pa'i mjug tu rgyas par na sde tshan so sor byas nas 'bul zhing*/ don gzhan du shes par byas la/ 'dir bsdus pa thun mong du 'bul ba'i dbang du byas na/ da lta gtso bo yab yum gnyis kyi sngags tsam gyi mjug tu mchod sngags sbyar nas 'bul ba dar zhing*/ bla ma kha cig shin tu bsdus pa la de rung bar bzhed pas/ de ltar na/ lha yi me tog dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs la/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dach-i ka spar+sha badz+ra puṣ+pe pratīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sil snyan dam pa 'di/ /zhes so sor sbyar nas rang rang gi sngags kyis 'bul lo/ kho bo ltar na tshul de n-i mchod pa rgyas par 'bul ba'i tshe gtso bo yab yum la sger du 'bul ba'i lugs ky-i shan shor ba sems zhing*/ bsdus te 'bul tshul ni 'di'i gong de ma thag dang bum bskyed dang sa chog gi skor rnams dang tshogs zhing btang rag gi mchod pa sogs kyi rigs 'gros sbyar na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ sogs so sor sbyar te phul na legs par mthong yang dpyad par bya'o/ /de min gtso bo yab yum gnyis kyi sngags kyi mthar sa pā ri wa ra zhes sbyar na legs sam snyam mo/ /nang gi nyer spyod lnga rol mo lag pa'i phyag rgya med par/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lor in+d+ra nī la ltar/ /shin tu sngo ba'i rdo rje'i bud pa yis/ /bskyod pa'i pad+mo las 'ongs me tog dmar/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ oṃ āḥnas pu pe pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ sprul ba'i 'khor lo gtum mo'i mes bsregs pas/

/yid 'ong dri yi ngad ldang ga bur spos/ /nyams su myong bas yid rab tshim byed pa/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sogs dang*/ dhu pe= chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus na bde ba'i dngos/ /hūṃ yig nyi ma gsal ba'i 'od zer can/ mi shes mun 'joms sngags kyi mar me mchog /mi bskyod= ā lo ke= bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus na legs gnas pa/ /kun+da ltar dkar dri yi byugs pa yis/ /lus kun khyab pas bde ba'i mchog ster ba/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i= gan+dhe= rmi lam yul la rol ba ji bzhin du/ /gang gang dbang po'i lam nas byung nas ni/ /de dang de yi yul la longs spyod zas/ /mi bskyod= nai wed+ye= snyoms 'jug dga' ba'i rol pa las byung ba'i/ /mi shigs yi ge mchog gi rol mo'i sgra/ /a li kā li'i gdangs su shar ba rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ= shap+ta pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ dang lha'i mtshan sngags rgyas bsdus ci rigs sbyar nas 'bul/ de nas/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bai ḍūr+ya/ sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs/ /rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ āḥnas rū pa zhes sogs dang*/ ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i/ /brjod bral dbyangs la sogs pa sgra yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la= /shap+ta sogs dang*/ ga bur a kar dza ti la sogs pa'i/ /legs par sbyar las byung ba dri yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la= gan+dhe zhes sogs dang*/ lus mchog rtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas sogs kyi/ / mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro/ /rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil khor lha yi ljags la= /ra sa zhes sogs dang*/ lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba/ /dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs/

/rnam gsum reg bya'i rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la dbul bar bya/ /spar sha dang sngags rgyas bsdus ci rigs sbyar nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te phul/ de nas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi la mkhas/ /yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho'i dpal yon can/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i gzugs mchog rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang*/ zur gyis lta zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can/ /drug ldan la sogs yang dag glu la mkhas/ pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i glu dbyangs mchog /mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba bzang po'i dri/ /gang gi lus la rtag tu rnam 'byung ba/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i dri mchog rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang*/ gang zhig myangs pas byang chub sems 'ju ba/ /bim+ba ltar dmar ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi sogs/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i ro mchog rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang*/ gsang ba'i sna rtse phan tshun phrad pa yi/ /reg bya myong bas gtum mo bskul byed pa/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i reg bya mchog /mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhes sogs dang*/ rang rang gi sngags sbyar nas nang gi 'dod yon 'bul zhing*/ nang gi 'dod yon la yang lag pa'i phyag rgya mi dgos so/ /de nas zhing 'di 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /zhes sogs so so'i sngags dang bcas pas sam/ yang na thun mong du/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang la/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin rer shes rab can gyis dbul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sap+ta rat+na pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pas rin chen bdun nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas 'bul/ de nas/ badz+ra dhṛka oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sogs kyi lha so so la nang mchod dang*/ yang nang mchod bzung ste/ bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid pa 'tshal/

/thugs ni rtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka nas sum+bha rā dza'i mthar pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'am/ bsdu na thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa sogs kyis bdud rtsi lnga dbul lo/ /rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ /gtso bo dang tha mi dad par gyur/ /yum reg bya rdo rje ma yongs su gyur pa las mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngo dmar/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ de'i snying gar hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ spyi bor oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ /zhes pa nas/ brla'i rtsa bar hā las don yod grub pa/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las nas rang nyid don grub tu gyur/ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rdo rje lam nas yum gyi pad+mar phyung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab las grub pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum nam mkha'i khams gang ba snyoms par zhugs pas mchod/ dkyil 'khor ba'i lha thams cad kyis kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong nas bde ba chen po dang de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas dgyes par gyur/ zhes gsang ba snyoms 'jug gi mchod pa dbul/ bdag ni mi bskyod rdo rje yis/ / chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin grong*/ yo byad ci 'byor ba yin ni/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u bas+thā nā ya/ āt+ma naṃ ni r+yā ta yā mi/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes bdag nyid dbul/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba/

/gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog/ oṃ a nu ta ra sarba pū dza me gha sa muṅga te spa ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yang na/ oṃ badz+ra wasta ye āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes gos dbul/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*/ / rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a laṅka ra wa bu ṣa ni āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes rgyan dbul/ brtse ba'i 'khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*/ ting 'dzin bla re spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ/ zhes nye bar mkho'i yo byad dbul/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di/ /sna tshogs bcud kyis bkang ste phul ba yis/ /las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun dag nas/ /byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /oṃ badz+ra ka la sha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes gang bum dbul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes mchod pa'i nga rgyal bzung*/ ma hā ra ta su dri ḍha su to ṣo/ su su kho/ badz+ra sa twa āḥdh+ya sid dh+ya maṃ/ lan gsum bskor ba dang*/ oṃ pra na ma mi sarba ta thā ga ta na/ zhes bsu phyag bya/ gzhung kha cig dang cho ga las ni/ sngags kyis phyag byas nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gang zhig gzugs dang zhes sogs kyi mjug tu khyab bdag mas bstod pa'i rjes su gang zhig thog med ces sogs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la zhes sogs dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byed par bshad cing*/ da lta ni bstod pa gzhan gnyis bzhag nas/ bshags pa sogs phyi ma gsum byas pa'i mjug tu/ oṃ pra na ma mi sarba zhes sogs kyis phyag byas te/ khyab bdag ma 'don pa dor/

'on kyang go rim 'brel ba'i dbang du byas na bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang yin sngon du btang nas sdig bshags sems bskyed sdom bzung rnams rjes su byas na legs par skabs 'di dang gzhung gzhan gyi rigs 'gros kyis shes la/ de nyid rab gsal las ni mi bskyod rdo rje'am gang zhig gzugs dang zhes pa gnyis gang rung gis bstod pa las gzhan ma bshad de rgyas bsdus so/ /bstod pa ni/ gzhung gi bstod pa gnyis dang*/ de nas/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ dbyer med bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor/ /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /gnyis snang spros pa'i kun rtog dbyings su thim/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rlung gi rgyu ba bcad/ /thams cad stong pa lhan skyes dga' ba'i mchog /bde chen chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srog 'dzin ches phra nor bu chu shel ni/ /rnam dag 'od gsal lha yi lam las 'ongs/ /rab dkar zla zer bye bas 'khyud pa'i sku/ /zung 'jug dang po'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ / mgon des sprul pa'i gar mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po dbang po'i gzhus/ /kun nas klubs pa ji bzhin yid 'phrog pa/ /zhi zhing 'dzum ldan mi bskyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rang rigs phyag rgya mchog gi mdzes ma dang*/ /snyoms 'jug lhan skyes dga' ba'i rol pa las/ /nyid sku'i cha shas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /'khor lo mchog tu sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mche ba rab dkar khro chags brjid pa'i zhal/ /mig sman mdog can nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od/ /mtshan dpe la 'gran rin chen rgyan mang mdzes/ /dpal ldan zhe sdang rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /de nyid thugs la dga' bskyed yid 'phrog ma/ /nu ma mngon dga' rin chen do shal dgod/ /reg bya rdo rje nam mkha'i mdzes pa 'phraug /mdzes sdug lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs phung rnam dag me long ye shes dngos/

/rnam bkra 'ja' tshon gos kyis 'khyud pa yi/ /zla ba'i phung po lta bu'i sku mnga' ba/ /rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshor ba rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes dngos/ /nyin byed bye ba'i mdangs ldan gser gyi ri/ /rnam mang rgyu skar do shal 'phyang ba bzhin/ /rab mdzes rin chen 'byung ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /'du shes rnam dag sor rtog ye shes dngos/ /li khri'i rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'od mnga' ba/ / 'jig rten kun gyi mig gi dga' ston mchog /mtha' yas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'du byed rnam dag bya sgrub ye shes dngos/ /mar gad phung po nyi 'od dang 'grogs pas/ /thub kun yin ni chags par byed pa bzhin/ /rab gsal don yod rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ khams bzhi rnam dag tshad med bzhi yi dngos/ /ut+pal mig can bim+ba'i mchu sgros can/ /zur gyis blta zhing bde ster bcom ldan ma/ /'jo sgeg lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras dga' ma gzugs sogs rnam dag cing*/ /dbang por bde ster chags pa'i nyams ldan ma/ /rab rtsed gar gyis rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ /dga' bskyed lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye mched tshigs dang rtsa rgyud rnam dag cing*/ /phyogs kyi bde gshegs 'od kyis 'khyud pa'i sku/ /lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan mang 'chang*/ / blo chen rgyal sras brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs 'bar ba'i mche ba can/ /ltos 'gro'i do shal spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyug /yan lag rnam dag dus mtha'i me dpung 'od/ /stobs chen khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i lhan skyes dga' ba'i rol ba las/ /du mar spro zhing cig car sdud pa dang*/ / gnyis med gnyis bral bde stong lha yi sku/ /rten dang brtan par shar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i rab dkar dge ba'i tshogs/ /ji snyed thob des 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /snying gi bum pa bde chen bdud rtsi'i chus/ /bde blag nyid du gang ba thob gyur cig

/ces pas bstod/ de nas bshags pa dang sdom pa gnyis gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar bzung la/ sngags rnams ci 'grub zlas nas mthar yig brgyas brtan par bya'o// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /sprul ba'i gar mdzad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso/ khro chags brjid nyams mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba/ /bcom ldan zhe sdang rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /nyid sku yid 'phrog mdzes sdug lha mo'i skur/ /rnam par bstan na rjes chags rol pa yis/ /gang gi thugs la lhan skyes dga' ba'i dpal/ /ster mdzad bcom ldan 'das ma la phyag 'tshal/ /phung lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /dbang sngon dung gser byi ru mar gad mdog /lha rdzas rgyan ldan 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i sku/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la phyag 'tshal/ khams dang yul bzhi rnam dag tshad med dngos/ /gzugs mdzes sgeg nyams yid 'ong bzhin 'dzum can/ /mchu sgros rab dmar zur lta ut+pal spyan/ /dga' ster lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa rgyus skye mched tshigs kun rnam dag cing*/ /rang phyogs bde gshegs mdog dang cha lugs bzhin/ /zab yangs spyod pa'i rgya mtsho cher rol ba/ /mthu chen rgyal sras brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus/ /spyan gsum sdang mig dbu skra dmar ser 'bar/ /rin chen sbrul rgyan ha ha'i gad rgyangs can/ /stobs ldan khro rgyal bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pas mchog thun dngos rnams dang*/ 'dus pa'i rim gnyis lam gyi gnad don kun/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i nyams len mthar phyin nas/ /sku gsum go 'phang myur du thob gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni bshad sgrub ming can gyis rang skal du dad pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa byams pa rin chen no// de nas 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma byin gyi brlabs nas/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa bkug te dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa ni/ /shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛ ka hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ sum+bha rā dza hūṃ hūṃ/ sarba zhes pa nas/ tsa ku ru swāhā/ oṃ āḥ dus gsum skyes pa zhes pa nas/ bsrung bar mdzad du gsol hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhrī:pra wa ra sad ka raṃ āñtsa mā ṇaṃ zhes pa nas/ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe zhes pa nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ badz+ra dhṛka oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ sum+bhā rā dza oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra puṣ+pa zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ badz+ra muḥ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma yod na byin gyis brlabs te 'bul zhing*/ btang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon rnams dag cing dri med sogs sngar bzhin tshigs bcad ci rigs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs sbyar nas 'bul lo/ /'dod yon lnga yang na/ phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs/ de bzhin gzugs la dbye ba gsum/ zhes sogs kyis phul nas bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis bstod/ de nas smon lam dang bzod gsol brtan bzhugs shis brjod bcas rje'i gsung dang mthun pa'i phyag len ltar bya ste 'dir bris so/ /gnyis pa bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ dbang rnon dang ras bris ma 'dzoms pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang mchod pa sogs sta gon byas nas bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du btang ste/ bsgrub tshul bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi dbang du byas na/

shūn+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su zhes pa nas byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ bcu rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ /rin po che/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ /rdo rje/ ut+pal/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ de rnams nas lha sum cu so gcig tu gyur pa ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du rang nyid mi bskyod pa zhi ba mthing nag nas rig ma bskyed pa ni dkyil 'khor/ rgya mchog bzhin dang de man chad mdun bskyed kyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'dir bzod gsol yan chad sngar bzhin byas pa'i mjug tu 'di ltar bya ste/ bdag la dngos grub mchog brtsal zhing*/ nas dngos grub bla na med pa stsol/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su 'khod pa ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ zhes pa nas/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po/ gzhal yas khang gi cha so so yang nas thim par gyur/ rang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad la dbang bskur/ zhes pa nas/ yo ga shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi skur gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la shis brjod bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas rang gzhan 'ga' la phan gdags par 'dod pa'i bsams pas dam pa gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun par cung zad re dbri bsnon byas te 'jug pa bde bar co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'i par shing rnams ni tshe ring bkra shis kyis dad pas bsgrubs pa dang yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa byams pa rin chen no//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khaur sgrub mchod bzhugs/ -PAGE 128--PAGE 129--PAGE 113-
